title: pleurophora polyandra var. typica
intro: Pleurophora polyandra var. typica, commonly known as Brazilian hawthorn, is a flowering plant species used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to help lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Therapeutic actions of Brazilian hawthorn include vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and cardiotonic effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
